name: LEP Point 2 (L3 cavern)
notes: Point number inferred by chaining two official CERN sources: 'the detector is ... based on the current magnet of LEP's L3 experiment ... When LEP switches off, the L3 magnet will be left in place whilst ALICE is installed' (src:lep-cern-courier-l3-magnet-alice) plus the voisins.cern and home.cern pages placing ALICE at Point 2 (src:lep-cern-voisins-point-2, src:lep-cern-alice-experiment-page). No single fetched sentence states 'L3 was at Point 2' verbatim.
REVIEW REQUIRED (A17): coordinates are an OpenStreetMap/Nominatim point for 'CERN - Point 2 (Alice)', not a surveyed or officially published coordinate for the cavern.

summary.plain: The underground cavern at Point 2 of the LEP ring, near the French village of Sergy, where the L3 detector recorded electron-positron collisions from 1989 to 2000. The same cavern and L3's huge magnet were later reused for the ALICE experiment.
summary.technical: LEP interaction point 2, in Sergy (Ain, France); housed the L3 detector for the full LEP programme. L3's solenoid magnet was left in place and is now ALICE's central magnet at the same point.
